parts.title: Entry requirements
parts.body:
Every country decides who can enter or leave through its borders. The Mexican authorities set and enforce entry rules. Check with the Mexican embassy or consulate before you travel.

Passport validity

Your passport must be valid for the whole of your stay. Immigration officers decide how long you may stay, and may ask to see a return or onward ticket, where you will be staying and that you have enough money for your visit.

Visa requirements

Whether you need a visa depends on your nationality and the purpose of your trip. Keep any immigration record you are given when you arrive: you may be asked for it during your stay and when you leave.

parts.title: Safety and security
parts.body:
Crime levels vary widely across Mexico. Stay aware of your surroundings, use registered taxis or ride-hailing apps, and follow the advice of local authorities.

Swimming and water safety

Strong currents and rip tides occur on many Pacific beaches, including in Oaxaca. Follow warning flags and the advice of lifeguards, and do not swim where there are no lifeguards or after drinking alcohol.

Hurricanes

The hurricane season normally runs from June to November. Monitor local news and follow the instructions of the authorities.

parts.title: Local laws and customs
parts.body:
Carry a copy of your passport and immigration record with you; police may ask for identification.

Illegal drugs

Possession of even small amounts of illegal drugs can lead to arrest and imprisonment.

E-cigarettes and vapes

Mexico restricts the import and sale of e-cigarettes and vaping devices, and they can be confiscated on arrival.

Alcohol

Some towns restrict drinking alcohol in public places. Check local rules before drinking on the street or the beach.

Driving

You need a valid driving licence to drive. Drink-driving laws are enforced, and an accident can lead to detention while responsibility is decided.

Medicines

Some prescription medicines available elsewhere are controlled in Mexico. Carry a copy of your prescription.

parts.title: Health
parts.body: See a health professional at least eight weeks before your trip for vaccine and health advice.
